Neoclouds have limited cybersecurity. Next time agents successfully go rouge, they'll try taking over a neocloud to run more copies. This is bad. Thus: neoclouds should greatly strengthen their cybersecurity and every company with strong cyber models should help with that.
RT @daniellevy__: Deep learning happens when a small, cracked team operates a big computer. The computer just got bigger.

Jensen Huang matters to Nvidia because he can take technologies his engineers believe are possible and turn them into products the whole company commits resources to, takes risks on, and has to deliver. That's why the supply chain gets such strong order visibility and is willing to keep up with aggressive spec upgrades. It also forces competitors to follow, which drives technology upgrades and supply chain investment across the entire AI industry. Between the two, deciding on aggressive spec upgrades and making them happen is the harder part, compared with giving the supply chain order visibility. Huang doesn't need to be the person at Nvidia who knows the most about new technologies like HVDC, CPO/NPO, or CCL/PTFE. His value is that he weighs strategy, organization, technology, and supply chain all at once, then makes the call quickly and puts resources behind it. Based on what's public so far, it looks hard for Huang to come out of this unscathed. If so, the practical move may be to gradually reduce Nvidia's reliance on Huang's personal decision-making while preparing a succession plan. Along the way, two things are worth watching to gauge where AI technology and investment are heading: whether Nvidia can keep developing new products and technologies as efficiently as before, and how competitors respond. Supply chain research will be an important basis for that judgment.

黃仁勳對 Nvidia 的重要性，在於他能把工程團隊認為可能實現的技術，轉化成全公司願意投入資源、承擔風險，而且必須交付的產品。正因如此，供應鏈才能有極高的訂單能見度，並配合激進的規格升級。而這也帶動了競爭對手的跟進，進一步推動整體 AI 產業的技術升級與供應鏈投資。 如果硬要比較，做出並落實激進規格升級的決策，比提供供應鏈訂單能見度更困難。黃仁勳不必是 Nvidia 內部最懂 HVDC、CPO/NPO 與 CCL/PTFE 等新技術的人，但他的價值，在於同時考慮到策略、組織、技術與供應鏈，並迅速拍板定案與投入資源執行。 就目前公開資訊，黃仁勳似乎很難全身而退。在這前提下，比較務實的做法，可能是階段性降低 Nvidia 對黃仁勳個人的決策依賴，同時布局接班計畫。而在這過程中，Nvidia 能否延續高效的新產品與新技術研發，以及競爭對手如何因應，將是觀察整體 AI 產業技術發展與投資趨勢的重點，而供應鏈研究則能提供重要的判斷依據。
